reason: Python's argparse took prog from the invoked script (tools/<tool>.py); the Go binaries are run as their installed command (tools/install.sh), so usage and help name that command, not a retired .py script.

usage: bognav [bog] pointcache [-h] [--json] [--csv] [--limit N] [--device DEVICE] [--stale]
                               [--live] [--stale-before STALE_BEFORE] [--summary]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                machine JSON output
  --csv                 CSV output (header + rows)
  --limit, -n N         print at most N rows (default: all); the cut is reported
  --device DEVICE       only this owning device instance
  --stale               only stale rows
  --live                only fresh rows
  --stale-before STALE_BEFORE
                        year YYYY; rows polled before it are STALE (default: newest year in the
                        cache)
  --summary             print only the freshness/year summary
